sections.Code Update Notes, posted 2026-02-04: Du:
Code Update 2/4/26
The sixth major code update for Dune Pinball features a significantly awesome update to Fedaykin Multiball, plus new volume boost controls for Arena & Dune modes, along with some more lightshows, polish, and improvements to make the game even hotter than the desert of Arrakis!
FEDAYKIN MULTIBALL UPDATE
This exciting update to Fedaykin Multiball now includes the desert’s fiercest warriors helping you vanquish Harkonnen harvesters – including new video and audio clips, rules, scoring boosts, and extended harvester action!
Rules / Objectives Updates:
Fedaykin Multiball is only available to start DURING a Harvester Battle and IF you locked a ball in the trap before starting (There is a setting to allow lock + start during if desired).
Fedaykin fills all the Harkonnen slots on the playfield on start and a thopter is added.
Re-Lighting Fedaykin Jackpot will also add another thopter and refill the Harkonnen again.
While Fedaykin Multiball is live, all points are boosted for kills / thopters / harvester.
While Fedaykin Multiball is running, water is not allowed to run out completely – it will stop decreasing at 10 left; if you drain out of Fedaykin Multiball before killing the harvester, water drain resumes and the battle can end.
After the harvester is destroyed, if Fedaykin Multiball is still running you attack more harvesters – the sacrifice is delayed and you continue with soldiers / thopters and any shot through the harvester is like a victory lap.If you drain to 1 ball after killing the harvester, the sacrifice phase begins and any shot that had Harkonnens killed, can be collected for water; the more that were killed, the more water you will be given.
ARENA & DUNE MODESVOLUME BOOST CONTROLS
A new “boosted” volume setting is now included for Arena and Dune modes. By default, it does nothing, but if you raise it above zero (0), those modes are now louder than general gameplay audio.
